findings.text: The mirror check used to be a no-op that always passed. It now enforces a character class of `[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]`, which excludes `:`, `~`, `%`, `@` and `?`. A valid mirror with a port, such as NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080/dist or http://mirror.local:3000, now fails with 'may only contain a URL' and returns 2. Every nvm install or ls-remote against that mirror breaks.
